component.name: AV Relay
component.summary: Use another computer's camera and microphone on this one

description.p: AV Relay makes the camera and microphone of another computer, the sender (today a Mac running AV Relay for macOS), show up on Ubuntu as a regular webcam ("AV Relay Camera") and microphone ("AV Relay Microphone") for any app, over the local network. The sender's camera and microphone run only while an app here uses them.
Pair once with a 6-digit code shown on the sender; the connection is encrypted end to end.
